entities.summary: Frank Nazar III is an American professional ice hockey player who is a center for the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted 13th overall by the Blackhawks in the 2022 NHL entry draft. He played college ice hockey at the University of Michigan.
